intro.heads_up: Quick heads-up before we dive in: by the time this episode drops Tuesday morning, the crest cap lifts and Ascendant Venomstones unlock with this week's reset, and the WoW: Forever Stress Test is Wednesday, October 21.
rundown: a batch of datamined mounts Blizzard says are not meant for Forever, and storms rolling into the beta
the October 15 Forever build, where the weapon racials finally go away
the WoW: Forever Podcast on PvP, and the $100K Forever Open happening this weekend
the road to launch: a free stress test, economy holds on gold buyers, and layering complaints
Liquid taking world first on Mythic Kith'ix, even without an official race
Patch 12.1.5 going live, and a rough first week in the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan
the Liadrin backlash after the Kith'ix finale
and we'll close out the news with Microsoft's earnings date

items.title: Not for This Version: Blizzard Guards Forever's Look
items.category: World of Warcraft: Forever, Art Direction
items.synopsis: Within hours of a retail-looking datamine, Blizzard said those cosmetics aren't coming to Forever, and the next day it was showing off the beta's new storms.
points: the October 15 beta build opening up new art through tactkeys

points.text: Spectral Wolf Pack, Verdant Sea Turtle, Crimson Rooster, three pets, a tent toy, and two transmog ensembles
points.sub: the Wolf Pack lets up to two nearby party members join in on their own wolves

points: a lot of players saying it looked straight out of the retail shop
Kaivax on the forums: these assets are not intended for this version of World of Warcraft
Clay Stone and art director Jeff Parrott both reposting that note on X

points.text: Blizzard not saying which version they are for
points.sub: Wowhead points out the Rexxar shop sets first showed up on China's Titan Reforged servers

points: the cash-shop question for Forever still unanswered
the next day, pre-storm weather and lightning strikes going live on the beta
lead environment artist Matt Heyman: fog and clouds roll in, distant thunder, then rain in stages
big thunderstorms meant to be rare, plus heavy blizzards added in Alterac Mountains
questions: If a Spectral Wolf Pack showed up in a Forever shop, would that bother you, or is cosmetic-only fine?
Fast denial on the datamine, big push on the weather. What does that tell you about what the Forever team is protecting?

items.title: The October 15 Build: Weapon Racials Are Gone
items.synopsis: The October 15 Forever build replaced every weapon specialization racial with flat crit, slowed down Blood Fury, and made a long list of buffs raid-wide.
points: Human Sword Specialization becoming Ruthless, 2% crit with any weapon
Orc Axe Specialization becoming Savage, 1% crit with any weapon
Dwarf and Tauren both getting 2% more crit damage and healing, and the forums hating it
Blood Fury going to a 3 minute cooldown, up from 2

points.text: Undead Touch of the Grave getting a 25 second internal cooldown
points.sub: it also stops breaking CC and no longer procs off things like Distract or Pickpocket

points: Troll, Skyborne, Gnome and Night Elf all coming out ahead
Battle Shout, Trueshot Aura, Leader of the Pack, Moonkin Form and Shaman totems now raid-wide
Hunter pets losing some power, with Dismember and Furious Howl cut down
Druid Mangle renamed Primal Bite, and Druid Wrath base damage up about 50%
respecs down to 1 silver for the beta only
questions: With weapon racials gone, does race choice still matter to you, or do you just pick what looks good?
Raid-wide buffs remove a lot of group shuffling. Good change, or does it lose something?

items.title: Forever PvP: The Podcast and the $100K Forever Open
items.synopsis: Episode 4 of the WoW: Forever Podcast was all PvP, and Blizzard is building an official arena for this weekend's $100K Forever Open.
points: Aggrend and Lead Designer Tim Jones on the podcast with Savix and Tips Out
Alterac Valley honor coming down, every other battleground's honor going way up
Tim Jones: they want Warsong, Arathi Basin and Darkspear Islands to feel worth your time

points.text: no protection planned for low-level players getting ganked
points.sub: Aggrend: PvP occurs on a PvP server, and that's been true for 22 years

points: no current plans for an RP-PvP ruleset, with Aggrend pointing to how those realms have actually played out
the Forever Open running October 17 and 18, with around 6,000 entrants
Blizzard opening Hyjal Crater as the official dueling arena on day two
NPCs selling soul shards and reagents, maybe a cooldown reset vendor too
questions: No low-level protection on PvP servers. Correct call, or is Forever leaving casual players to get camped?
Would you rather grind honor in Warsong and Arathi, or does AV still win?

items.title: Road to Launch: Stress Test, Economy Holds, and Layering
items.synopsis: With launch on November 4, Forever gets a free stress test, a new weapon against gold buyers, and some layering complaints Blizzard is still working on.
points: the Stress Test moving to Wednesday, October 21, two days later than first announced
open to anyone, no subscription, Game Time, invite, or beta access needed

points.text: 2:00 p.m. PDT in North America, 19:00 CEST in Europe
points.sub: pick World of Warcraft: Forever Stress Test from the Game Version menu in Battle.net

points: every stress test character, name and guild wiped before name reservations open October 27
Temporary Economy Holds locking trade, mail, guild bank and Auction House on suspected RMT accounts
Blizzard admitting there may be false positives, but no permanent strike unless RMT is proven
and if it works, rolling it out to every version of WoW
leaving a group now moving the group leader to a new layer too
bordering zones sitting on different layers, like Dalaran and Silverpine
Tim Jones calling layering a work in progress with incremental steps
questions: Are you jumping into the stress test, or saving yourself for launch?
Economy holds with possible false positives. Would you rather risk the occasional wrong hold, or have the gold sellers?

items.title: Race to World First: Liquid Takes Mythic Kith'ix
items.synopsis: There was no official Race to World First for 12.1.5, but Liquid still got the world first kill on Mythic Kith'ix.
points: Kith'ix opening October 13 in North America and October 14 in Europe
a single-boss raid, with flexible Mythic for 15 to 25 players
no official race this patch, and Liquid racing it anyway
Liquid on top at Raider.io, followed by SOMA, Vulgar and Consequence
Advance the first EU guild on the list, at number seven

points.text: Lu'selama, Light's Justice and Twisted Horror's Tendril dropping at item level 340
points.sub: Wowhead also spotted a Libram of the Matriarch and a Shadeweaver's Hearthstone in the loot

points: Blizzard easing Mythic Sszorak and the Coiled Altar the same week
and the Venomous Abyss Hall of Fame now closed
questions: No official race and Liquid still went all in. Is an unofficial world first worth anything?
One-boss raid with flex Mythic. Something you'd want our team to push?

items.title: Patch 12.1.5 Is Live
items.synopsis: 12.1.5 brought the Kith'ix raid, the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan, a mid-season power bump, and a new campaign back to Quel'Thalas and Zul'Aman.
points: the Unbinding of Kith'ix, with Lady Liadrin at your side, in Story, Normal, Heroic and Mythic
the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan, a nine-chamber Delve-style gauntlet with Mythic gear and a Tier 11 solo challenge
Keystone Myth back for Season 2, needing a 3600 rating

points.text: Ascendant Venomstones unlocking the week of October 20
points.sub: 10 of them raise a fully upgraded Hero, Myth, or max Tidal Crafted weapon, trinket, or necklace

points: the crest cap lifting the same week
Aqir Invasions in Eversong or Zul'Aman, ten minutes every hour
Altar of Fangs and Ruby Life Pools nerfed for Mythic+
Subtlety Rogues getting 14% more ability damage in a late patch note update
Blizzard fixing Voidcore trackers for players who were briefly suspended over extra bonus rolls
questions: Ascendant Venomstones and the crest cap lift both land next week. What are you upgrading first?
Keystone Myth at 3600. Anyone in the guild going for it?

items.title: The Labyrinth of Kindo'jan: A Rough First Week
items.synopsis: The Labyrinth launched with run-ending bugs and three days of hotfixes, and it turns out you can't save a run.
points: all nine chambers in one run to reach Kindo'jan
bosses not giving credit and Returning the Bounty getting stuck, ending runs early

points.text: Kindo'jan's platform sometimes not spawning, so you fall through the floor and die
points.sub: Blizzard: two map configurations overlapping in a very specific case, hard to catch in testing

points: hotfixes on October 14, 15 and 16, and players still reporting credit bugs after the first round
no save points, so a long logout resets the whole run
Blizzard's own wording saying you could tackle it piece by piece over time
Valeera dying instantly, with Blizzard investigating and fixing her Stagger with a healer around
tip: Mislaid Curiosity buffs last the whole run, so stack them before Kindo'jan
tip: 44 Sturdy Chests for reputation and the Treasure Hound title
questions: Has either of you made it all the way to Kindo'jan yet, or has a bug ended your run?
Should a 30-plus minute run let you save, or is all-in-one-sitting part of the challenge?

items.title: Liadrin's Send-Off: The 12.1.5 Story Backlash
items.synopsis: The Kith'ix finale ends Lady Liadrin's story, and a lot of players think she deserved much better.
points: spoiler warning before we start this one
Liadrin channeling the Light like in the Midnight cinematic, then collapsing after the fight
Icy Veins calling it one of the most unceremonious, anticlimactic deaths in WoW history
the common complaint: not enough build-up for a character who's been around since TBC
Windows Central's Jez Corden calling it one of the weakest character deaths he's seen
no public Blizzard response to the criticism that we could find

points.text: the post-raid quests What the World Sees and Belly of the Beast bugged at launch
points.sub: the end of that questline awards the Blade and Shield of the Blood Knight Matriarch cosmetics

questions: Did Liadrin's death land for you, or did it feel rushed?
Is the faster patch schedule hurting the story, or is this just how WoW does character deaths now?

items.title: Microsoft: Earnings on October 28
items.synopsis: A quiet week for Xbox business news, but Microsoft's next earnings report, with the first gaming numbers since July, comes out October 28.
points: Microsoft reporting fiscal 2027 first-quarter results after market close on Wednesday, October 28
the earnings webcast at 2:30 p.m. Pacific
the first look at Xbox and gaming revenue since the July report
MSFT stock falling to about $525 on October 16 after failing to set a new high above $550
the slide blamed on a UK regulator probe and heavy AI infrastructure spending, not gaming
and we'll have the Xbox numbers for you next episode
questions: What number would tell you Microsoft is happy with Xbox right now?
